summary: Brightstar Lottery PLC (NYSE: BRSL), a foreign private issuer filing Form 6-K, announced repurchases of 945,593 ordinary shares for an aggregate $9,999,995.34 under its $500 million buyback program announced July 1, 2025. Individual purchases ranged from $10.10 to $11.03 per share across three dates in July and August 2026. Shares were placed in treasury, reducing outstanding share count. The filing is a routine capital-return disclosure with no strategic implications. What to watch: pace of remaining buyback capacity and any acceleration or suspension of the program.
